nodes.name: sprite.cpp
nodes.summary: 2D sprite rasterizer that uploads quads (and a radial-fill fan) through the shared 2D shaders, with rotation, atlas UVs, and color tint.
nodes.languageNotes: Sprite_Draw overloads funnel into one textured-quad path; Sprite_DrawRadialFill builds a triangle fan for circular progress.

nodes.name: sprite.h
nodes.summary: Public 2D sprite API: initialize/finalize plus draw overloads and radial-fill drawing for circular progress indicators.

nodes.name: texture.cpp
nodes.summary: Texture slot manager that loads WIC/DirectXTex images, creates RGBA atlases, caches a 1x1 white texture, and loads DDS cubemaps.
nodes.languageNotes: Fixed arrays of 1024 2D textures and 64 cubemaps; TextureAllRelease also clears the UI font cache.

nodes.name: texture.h
nodes.summary: Declares texture and cubemap load/bind/release APIs used by sprites, UI, particles, and the skybox.

nodes.name: scene_canvas.cpp
nodes.summary: Owns the shared in-game UI canvas: JSON load/save of sprites, text, buttons, and bars, plus HUD bindings, button actions, and respawn overlay/timer helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Anonymous-namespace JSON helpers plus a button-action registry that defaults LoadScene to SceneCanvas_RequestSceneFile.

nodes.name: Sprite_Initialize
nodes.summary: Creates the 2D sprite vertex buffer and a larger radial-fill vertex/index pair.

nodes.name: Sprite_Finalize
nodes.summary: Releases sprite and radial-fill GPU buffers.

nodes.name: Sprite_Draw
nodes.summary: Draws a textured 2D quad with optional atlas UVs, rotation, and color; overloads forward here.

nodes.name: Sprite_DrawRadialFill
nodes.summary: Draws a circular-progress sprite by uploading a triangle fan clipped to fill amount and origin.

nodes.name: Texture_Initialize
nodes.summary: Stores the D3D11 device and context used by later texture loads.

nodes.name: Texture_Finalize
nodes.summary: Releases all 2D textures and cubemaps held by the manager.

nodes.name: TextureLoad
nodes.summary: Loads or reuses a texture by wide path via DirectXTex and returns a slot id.

nodes.name: TextureCreateFromRGBA
nodes.summary: Creates a texture slot from raw RGBA bytes, used for baked font atlases.

nodes.name: TextureGetWhiteTexture
nodes.summary: Lazily creates and returns the cached 1x1 white texture id.

nodes.name: TextureAllRelease
nodes.summary: Releases every 2D texture slot and clears the UI font cache.

nodes.name: TextureSetTexture
nodes.summary: Binds a texture slot SRV to pixel-shader slot 0, or unbinds if invalid.

nodes.name: TextureGetSize
nodes.summary: Returns the width and height of a texture slot.

nodes.name: CubemapLoad
nodes.summary: Loads or returns a cached DDS cubemap SRV for skybox rendering.

nodes.name: CubemapReleaseAll
nodes.summary: Releases every cached cubemap SRV.

nodes.name: EnsureDefaultButtonActions
nodes.summary: Registers the built-in LoadScene button action that requests a scene file from the canvas.

nodes.name: AnchorFromString
nodes.summary: Parses a JSON anchor name into a UIAnchor enum.

nodes.name: AnchorToString
nodes.summary: Serializes a UIAnchor enum back to its JSON name.

nodes.name: TextAlignFromString
nodes.summary: Parses a text-align string used by UIText elements.

nodes.name: TextAlignToString
nodes.summary: Serializes a text-align value for canvas JSON.

nodes.name: ReadFloat2
nodes.summary: Reads an XMFLOAT2 from a JSON array.

nodes.name: WriteFloat2
nodes.summary: Writes an XMFLOAT2 as a JSON array.

nodes.name: ReadColor
nodes.summary: Reads an RGBA color from JSON with defaults.

nodes.name: WriteColor
nodes.summary: Writes an RGBA color as a JSON array.

nodes.name: NormalizeSceneFile
nodes.summary: Normalizes a requested scene path so canvas buttons can load it consistently.

nodes.name: ApplyCommon
nodes.summary: Applies shared JSON fields such as visibility to a freshly loaded UI element.

nodes.name: LoadElementScript
nodes.summary: Attaches a canvas script to an element from JSON.

nodes.name: AppendElementScript
nodes.summary: Writes an element script block back into serialized JSON.

nodes.name: ReadOnClickScript
nodes.summary: Reads a button onClick script payload from JSON.

nodes.name: BindSceneHudElements
nodes.summary: Rebinds well-known HUD pointers (score, timer, red overlay) after canvas reload.

nodes.name: LoadSpriteElement
nodes.summary: Deserializes a UISprite from canvas JSON including texture path and color.

nodes.name: LoadTextElement
nodes.summary: Deserializes a UIText element including font, align, and color.

nodes.name: LoadButtonElement
nodes.summary: Deserializes a UIButton with state textures, action, and onClick script.

nodes.name: LoadBarElement
nodes.summary: Deserializes a UIBar including fill/background textures and value range.

nodes.name: SerializeCommon
nodes.summary: Writes shared element fields (name, anchor, position) into JSON.

nodes.name: SerializeElementJson
nodes.summary: Serializes a live UIElement (sprite/text/button/bar) to a JSON object for save/undo.

nodes.name: SceneCanvas_Initialize
nodes.summary: Creates the shared UICanvas, registers default button actions, and binds HUD elements.

nodes.name: SceneCanvas_Finalize
nodes.summary: Destroys the shared canvas and clears HUD element pointers.

nodes.name: SceneCanvas_Update
nodes.summary: Ticks the shared scene canvas.

nodes.name: SceneCanvas_Draw
nodes.summary: Draws the shared scene canvas.

nodes.name: SceneCanvas_ClearSceneCanvas
nodes.summary: Removes all canvas elements and rebinds HUD pointers.

nodes.name: SceneCanvas_LoadSceneCanvas
nodes.summary: Rebuilds the canvas from a JSON document by dispatching per-type loaders.

nodes.name: SceneCanvas_SaveSceneCanvas
nodes.summary: Serializes the current canvas element list to JSON.

nodes.name: SceneCanvas_SerializeElement
nodes.summary: Serializes one element to a JSON string for editor undo.

nodes.name: SceneCanvas_GetElementIndex
nodes.summary: Returns the index of an element pointer in the canvas list, or -1.

nodes.name: SceneCanvas_RemoveElementInternal
nodes.summary: Removes an element and refreshes HUD bindings.

nodes.name: SceneCanvas_BindButtonAction
nodes.summary: Applies a registered action binder to a button by its action name.

nodes.name: SceneCanvas_RegisterButtonAction
nodes.summary: Registers or replaces a named button-action binder.

nodes.name: SceneCanvas_RequestSceneFile
nodes.summary: Queues a scene file (and optional play-on-load) for the next consume.

nodes.name: SceneCanvas_ConsumeRequestedSceneFile
nodes.summary: Returns and clears the pending scene-file request.

nodes.name: SceneCanvas_ShowRedOverlay
nodes.summary: Shows the full-screen red respawn overlay sprite.

nodes.name: SceneCanvas_HideRedOverlay
nodes.summary: Hides the red respawn overlay.

nodes.name: SceneCanvas_SetRedOverlayAlpha
nodes.summary: Sets the red overlay sprite alpha.

nodes.name: SceneCanvas_SetTimerSeconds
nodes.summary: Updates the top-middle scene timer text from a seconds value.
